reviews.review: This program will not let me login, nor will it let me reset my password, buggy piece of ♥♥♥♥.
The Evolution Engine has stopped working.

I liked it at one point. "Ninjas play free" and all that.

And then a multi-year barrage of content—quality ranging from underwhelming to downright terrible—started hitting the game and never stopped. Content, mind you, that was teased via extremely misleading marketing for years prior. As such, my view has been irreversibly soured. Every few years I'll still peek at this game to see the number of content islands has again multiplied, except now they don't even bother to maintain the game's aesthetic anymore.

(Hire someone who can write, btw)

So, i gave this game a try. The gameplay is really fun and like every grinding game it is addicting, BUT this isn't a noob friendly game. If anything it is exactly the opposite. Each time i had questions about quests, crafting or anything i had to google because the game barely explains the basics. 

Apart from that, if you are not willing to spend hours on this game-and by hours i mean more than 500 from my understanding- don't even bother playing. It is one of those games you have to invest time/money in order to say it was worth it. I played for 60 hours doing quests, grinding, crafting, exploring and seriously my progress felt so slow. IMO, the ''problem'' with this game is that you have to spend hours in order to unlock the specific Warframe you want to main and then reset it several times in order to reach its max potential. It would have been better if you could choose a specific Warframe and then level it up and by crafting to evolve it. For example, start with Rhino, then craft/grind to evolve it to Rhino Prime etc. I started with Volt, got Rhino and then farmed, farmed, farmed for 60 hours till i got bored. And now i am writing this review. Well, that's my opinion about this game. I might be wrong, but the game doesn't help new players much so i can't know for sure.
it is fun to play but a lot of the stuff is a lot of money and I do not won't ro play a game with high money. But I love playing the game so plz. make some new stuff.
